summary: Two demonstrated defects: translated answer banks expose a perfect prompt-blind shortcut, including all five delivered batch questions; three current source banks cannot be reproduced. Independent math, native grading, rendering and packaging checks pass. Package unchanged; no database writes or asset publication.

source_analysis.skill: Use rank(A)+nullity(A)=number of columns to recover one missing dimension from the other, for an explicitly sized matrix.
reasoning_steps: Read m by n in the stated order.
Identify whether rank or nullity is supplied and which is requested.
Apply rank+nullity=n and solve by one integer subtraction.
Select the matching value from five math radio choices.
invariants: m,n positive integers; 0 <= rank <= min(m,n); nullity=n-rank.
One supplied dimension, one requested dimension; no extra matrix calculation.
Solution states theorem, identifies n, substitutes, subtracts and gives answer.
Rows may affect feasibility but do not replace columns in the theorem.
permitted_variations: Vary row and column counts, including tall, wide and square matrices, while preserving feasibility and small arithmetic.
Vary feasible rank, hence nullity, including full-rank or zero boundaries as conservative same-method extensions.
Vary target rank versus nullity; target is an eligible answer-bearing role, not fixed by incidental source arrangement.
Vary correct numerical value, distractor values and answer positions while retaining five distinct choices.
Hold n and supplied value fixed and vary feasible m: answer should remain fixed. Hold shape and target fixed and vary given dimension: answer must change.

source_replay.details: 11 of 14 current source questions reproduce their prompts, worked solutions and complete banks. q-141221, q-142482 and q-141190 are absent; none of the supported profiles reproduces their full banks at original parameters. Canonical example has no supplied answer bank.

math.details: Independent prompt parsing verifies matrix feasibility, answer n minus supplied dimension, five distinct nonnegative options, and concrete theorem/substitution/subtraction in 269 sampled/batch records plus 10 controlled records. Both targets and tall, wide, square shapes tested.

variety.details: Both targets and broad numerical/shape variation survive resampling and delivery, but only 11 of 14 observed bank profiles are supported. Missing complete banks are a demonstrated source-family coverage restriction. Incidental decision cues are assessed separately below.

scope.details: Supported outputs retain easy, one-step rank-nullity substitution with one five-choice radio response. No row reduction, basis extraction or extra theorem introduced. Unsupported moderate/hard levels and invalid field/parameter combinations reject explicitly.

grading.details: Actual learning::grade_field: 83 accepted, 164 rejected, zero unresolved. Includes all five choices for 41 records, both counterfactual types, all surviving batch records, and the exact minimal shortcut action. Equivalent free-entry notation is inapplicable to the source radio contract.

rendering.details: Actual unmodified UI renders all five normalized batch records and ten controlled records: 15/15 pass. Screenshots inspected for readable prompts, shuffled radio choices and aligned worked solutions. Rendered text also independently checked against each changed parameter.

packaging.details: Relocated manifest package reproduces the public CLI output. Exact installed dependencies match manifest: Python 3.13.5, sympy 1.14.0. Seed replay and rejection checks pass. All declared package files and manifest remain byte-identical.

decision_variation.details: Target plus sorted answer gaps determines the correct numerical rank: 264/264 raw controls, 257/257 post-deduplication controls and 5/5 exact surviving batch records, versus 20% guessing. Every recognizable signature is also perfect conditionally. Relevant and irrelevant counterfactual dependencies pass, but do not remove this bypass. Read-only selection reproduction and freshness exclusions cannot break a per-record perfect rule; actual policy/history and future entity IDs are unavailable. Captured inventory basis 5446 has only 14 original source questions and zero stored generated questions.

findings.description: Every generalized bank is a fixed translation of a source offset vector. Consequently the visible target and sorted option-gap pattern identify which numerical order statistic is correct without reading columns or the supplied dimension. Minimal example: seed 829013 yields a 9×12 matrix with nullity 7, asks rank, and offers [2,3,4,5,6]; selecting the second-largest value 5 succeeds. Within this recognizable rank/consecutive-bank subgroup the shortcut is 34/34 in fresh controls (32/32 after delivery). The exact runner batch also fails: the target/gap lookup answers all five surviving members. UI shuffling does not alter numerical ranks.
